sara-cs: Day0 scrub for CedarRun private/VPC onboarding 1: quick pass on routing, NAT egress, KMS cross-account, CloudTrail -> S3 ingestion. Calling out any known blockers now so we can capture for the renewal review.
ben-se: Peering + TGW attachment are in place. Route table rtb-cc12 missing entry for telemetry subnet 10.72.4.0/24 -> tgw-0c9d. I can push a static route if folks want.
kevin-eng: Thanks @ben-se; before you push, confirm whether the customer expects source-NAT at their collector. If they expect direct source IP, we need to change the proxy config.
ben-se: They want source-NAT preserved (collector whitelist), so we keep NAT GW for egress 443. I'll add the TGW route for intra-VPC traffic and keep 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0f3a.
raj-infra: I added the 10.72.4.0/24 -> tgw-0c9d route at 14:06Z; propagation shows "available". Ran a quick tcpdump on proxy: SYN to collector 35.198.120.12 hits, response 403 from collector (IP not whitelisted).
audit-bot: cloudtrail_event: Trail "cedarrun-org-trail" created at 2026-05-11T14:02Z
kevin-eng: KMS: the key alias/cedarrun-audit currently has a policy scoped to account-root only. Customer expects cross-account decrypt from `arn:aws:iam::444555666:role/cedar-ops`. We need an explicit statement for that principal and kms:Decrypt/kms:GenerateDataKey actions.
sara-cs: @raj-infra can you confirm if we have a fallback plan in case the customer doesn't approve the KMS statement before the renewal checkpoint next week?
raj-infra: Mitigation logged: temporary envelope key we manage (audit-only) is available but requires contract addendum and will change CMK ARN in the runbook. Added to risk tracker as "temporary-ingest-key fallback".
ben-se: Also note customer asked for audit S3 lifecycle to be 7 years and public access block. Runbook currently references 365 days, so update required.
kevin-eng: For the bucket policy, initial delivery failed with PutObject 403. Root cause: bucket policy had an explicit Deny for non-org principals. Adding CloudTrail service principal allow fixed re-delivery. Snippet I used: `{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::cedarrun-audit-bkt/AWSLogs/444555666/*"}`. I'll paste full policy into the runbook.
sara-cs: Great. Risk: If KMS cross-account isn't approved by Thu, we escalate renewal risk to AM/Sales. @ben-se add to tracker with owner.
ben-se: Done: "KMS cross-account approval pending" assigned to sara-cs, mitigations listed. Customer ETA for policy review: Friday afternoon per PM.
raj-infra: Quick validation command they can run after policy change: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://test.enc --key-id alias/cedarrun-audit`. If they get AccessDenied, check key policy & IAM permissions on role.
kevin-eng: I ran a local test after adding the ops role statement in our test key: decrypt succeeded. CloudTrail PutObject retries succeeded after the bucket policy change.
sara-cs: Outstanding network item: collector whitelist. Please DM PM asking them to add 35.198.120.12 and 3.134.66.77 to their allowlist.
ben-se: Pinged PM, they said they will add 35.198.120.12 now and confirm within 2 hours.
audit-bot: delivery_retry: CloudTrail delivery to cedarrun-audit-bkt reattempt succeeded at 2026-05-11T14:25Z
sara-cs: Summary action items: raj - confirm collector reachability after whitelist and confirm route propagation log by 18:00 UTC; ben - keep risk tracker updated and follow up on whitelist; kevin - paste final KMS + bucket policy snippets into runbook and update lifecycle retention; sara - schedule renewal check-in Friday 15:00 UTC and include AM. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
